question: I want to run a half marathon. I ran one in 1:38 three years ago, before a knee injury that has healed; no pain now. Make me a 4-week plan from next Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.

propose_program.name: 4 weeks toward a half marathon
propose_program.rationale: Toward your half marathon: the long run starts at your recent 6 km and grows at most 10% (L1a, P31), reaching about 8 km in four weeks; your 1:38 from before the injury doesn't count as current form; week 4 lighter (L2, P27).

must: Keep the half marathon as the goal and present the plan as a step toward it
Say plainly what is realistic in these four weeks (e.g. the long run only reaches about 7-8 km, so more weeks are needed before a half marathon)
Explain briefly that the old 1:38 half marathon from before the injury doesn't set the starting point
must_not: Change the goal to a shorter distance (such as 5 km or 10 km) without asking the user
